The paper does not report any squalene production by engineered HBQA7, so no titer is available.

Squalene appears only once, on page 11, as an untapped target. The authors write that there is "untapped potential for fatty acid derivatives... polyketides... and longer-chain terpenoids (e.g., taxadiene, squalene, β-carotene)." Table 2 (page 9), which lists the engineered products and their titers, has no squalene entry.
question: How much squalene did the engineered HBQA7 strain produce?
